title: plugin-form: the redirect `delayMs` timer outlives the component — a submitter who leaves during the delay is yanked back by a full-page navigation
body:
Found while implementing objectui#4989 (the contract half of the same two call sites). Filed unassigned, NOT fixed there — #4989's card scopes itself to five named defects and this is not one of them.

## What

`ObjectForm` and `WizardForm` arm the declared `submitBehavior: { kind: 'redirect' }` delay with a bare `setTimeout` inside the submit handler:

- `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` (redirect arm of the `submitBehavior` switch)
- `packages/plugin-form/src/WizardForm.tsx` (same arm)

```
setTimeout(() => window.location.assign(verdict.url), behavior.delayMs ?? 0);
```

Nothing ties that timer to the component. It is not stored, not cleared on unmount, and not owned by an effect. So for the whole of `delayMs` there is a pending full-page navigation that survives the form being taken off screen.

## Consequence

A submitter who acts during the delay gets pulled away from wherever they went. The reachable shapes, in rising order of how ordinary they are:

- the form is a modal/drawer variant (`ModalForm`, `DrawerForm` both wrap these), the user dismisses it after the confirmation and starts doing something else — then the timer fires and the browser leaves the page.
- the host is an SPA and the user clicks any in-app link during the delay; the timer's `window.location.assign` overrides that navigation with a full page load.
- the host unmounts the form for its own reasons (route change, tab switch, data refresh that re-keys a subtree).

`delayMs` exists precisely so the confirmation is readable before the redirect, so a non-trivial value is the intended authoring, not an edge case. The longer the declared delay, the wider the window.

## Prior art in this repo — the same defect, already fixed on the console side

`apps/console`'s `FormPage` had this and PR #4992 moved the wait into an effect keyed on the pending destination, with a `clearTimeout` cleanup. Its changeset states the reason in one line: "the wait now lives in an effect tied to the component, so a submitter who navigates away during the delay is no longer yanked back by a timer that outlived the page."

So the fix shape is already decided and demonstrated in this repo; this is the same move for the published renderer's two call sites. It should not change `delayMs` semantics at all — the pause stays a pause, an unset value still means "go now".

## Reachability, honestly

Needs a form authoring a `redirect` behaviour WITH a `delayMs`, and an unmount or navigation inside that window. Nobody loses data — the write has already succeeded before the timer is armed — so the harm is a surprising navigation, not corruption. Cheap to fix and cheap to pin (arm the delay, unmount, assert nothing was assigned).

## Not to be confused with

objectui#4989, which is about WHAT the url means (relative-only, interpolation, escaping, and refusing an out-of-contract value loudly). That card's PR leaves the timer exactly as it found it. This issue is only about the timer's lifetime.
